[P2] Include the testing-model fixes in the root-cause account

Rule 5, **A bug fix starts with a failing test**, requires the description to name each bug's root cause. The description discusses fixture publication and evidence-protocol problems but does not explain these shipped testing-library fixes: terminal events retaining retry metadata and event-ID reassignment dropping invocation completion details. Those changes affect public history results independently of the fixture. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and include their causes and reproducing tests in the agreed scope.
